title: The Parish of Greywater Bay
author: Emrys Pemberton
blurb: Elodie Blackwood, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
